alternatives_rejected.candidate: currencyservice: socket exhaustion as primary fault
alternatives_rejected.why: Socket z=20.75 is less than half the mem z=43.35 (E1), which fits sockets backing up behind a memory-starved process rather than a separate socket fault.

Its CPU fell (z=-3.35, -28.4%, E1), which fits a service waiting on a slow upstream rather than one that is overloaded. It sits behind currencyservice on the slow paths (E3) and has no deviation of its own pointing at it.
Its socket deviation is only mild (z=3.03, E1), and it is the entry point of every slow trace (E3), which is consistent with waiting on downstream calls.

proposed_fix.description: Raise the memory limit for currencyservice and scale out its replicas to relieve memory pressure. Then do a rolling restart of the currencyservice pods to reclaim leaked memory. Capture a heap profile before the restart so the leak in the conversion path can be found and fixed.
